summary: A student-scale, lavender one-pager for an experimental variable display font with three custom axes (Inktrap, Balloon, Curve): a wordmark that inflates letter by letter, a video grid of morphing Ms, one auto-playing slider per axis, a small slider tester, a poster carousel and a full glyph grid switchable between the eight axis extremes. Bilingual DE/EN toggle.

instances.look: On flat lavender, the lowercase name 'marbla' at ~230px in charcoal, a short paragraph under it, a round 'DE' language pill top-left and 'Experimental Variable Font' top-right
instances.ux: The name's letters inflate and curl one after another (each letter its own span with staggered axis values), then deflate back to the thin Regular, on a loop; the DE/EN pill swaps all copy between German and English
instances.learn: Animate a variable wordmark per letter with a phase offset: the wave through the name shows the axes more vividly than a uniform morph

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed ~800px; Bootstrap fluid grid with a 1-column left gutter (~120px); wordmark at x≈135, y≈190–380; paragraph col-5 (~560px) below at y≈500; thin rule at the bottom of the section
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark ~230px Marbla (blln/curv/iktr 0 → ~60), charcoal #222; paragraph ~16px Marbla Regular, leading ~1.6; top labels ~14px
reconstruction.behaviour: Two-dot loader, then each of span#m, #a1, #r, #b, #l, #a2 animates font-variation-settings 'blln','curv','iktr' together from 0 to ~60+ and back, offset ~20 units per letter (JS-driven loop)
reconstruction.content: Family name and a real description paragraph

instances.look: A black panel with a 13×8 grid of lavender capital Ms, each at a different point between thin Regular and fully inflated Balloon/Curve, forming diagonal waves
instances.ux: Looping muted video; a separate portrait video for mobile
instances.learn: Repeat one glyph in a grid and sweep its axes as a travelling wave: the whole design space reads as motion

reconstruction.layout: Black panel ~1200×670px centred in the lavender band (margins ~120px), aspect ~16:9
reconstruction.typography: Capital M, Marbla, ~70px cells, lavender #d4d0eb on black
reconstruction.behaviour: Autoplay loop video (M_1.mp4 desktop, M_mobil.mp4 mobile); could be rebuilt with CSS keyframes on font-variation-settings and per-cell animation-delay

instances.look: Three axis names in a stepped diagonal, each set in its own axis: 'Inktrap', 'Balloon', 'Curve' at ~115px, each above a thin slider line with a dot handle and a 3-line caption
instances.ux: Each word animates along its own axis while the (disabled) slider handle moves in sync, so the slider acts as a progress readout
instances.learn: Use a non-interactive slider as an animated gauge under each axis word: visitors read the axis position without having to touch anything

reconstruction.layout: Section ~756px; three blocks staggered: Inktrap at x≈600, Balloon at x≈390, Curve at x≈750, each word over a ~320px slider line and a ~300px caption
reconstruction.typography: Axis words ~115px Marbla with only that axis active (iktr / blln / curv 0–100); captions ~12px Marbla Regular charcoal
reconstruction.behaviour: JS loop: one axis value 0→100→0 per word, with input[type=range][disabled] value mirroring it (flairSlider, signSlider, boxSlider)
reconstruction.content: Axis name as the sample; one-sentence definition per axis

instances.look: A row of three thin labelled sliders (Inktrap, Balloon, Curve) above an editable pangram 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'; at the right three icon-labelled sliders for size, spacing and line height
instances.ux: Type in the sample; sliders change the three axes, font size (1–8vw), letter-spacing (−0.3 to 0.3rem) and line height (80–160%)
instances.learn: Put axis sliders above the text and typographic sliders beside it, each marked by a tiny icon instead of a word

reconstruction.layout: Section ~534px; axis sliders 3 × ~200px at y≈100 from x≈135; sample col (~800px) below; settings column at x≈990 with three 300px sliders, icons above each
reconstruction.behaviour: input oninput=changeMarblaTester() writes font-variation-settings 'iktr','blln','curv' (0–100), font-size vw, letter-spacing rem and line-height % to #testerText
reconstruction.assets: Three small PNG icons (size.png, spacing.png, line-height.png)

instances.look: A framed Bootstrap carousel of black-and-lavender poster banners: e.g. a waterfall of each letter morphing from thin to inflated beside a designspace cube of 'b' at its eight axis corners and a black 'INFINITE' bar; other slides set phrases like 'CRYING AT THE DISCOTHEQUE / POP UP / GLOOMING NIGHT SKIES'
instances.ux: Auto-advancing slides with thin dash indicators and Previous/Next arrows; separate slide set for mobile
instances.learn: Pack the explanatory diagrams (axis cube) and mood posters into one carousel so the page stays short

reconstruction.layout: Carousel ~1200×650px centred with a thin outline frame; slides are full-bleed JPG banners; dash indicators bottom centre
reconstruction.typography: Slide type in Marbla across the axes, mostly caps, lavender on black or black on lavender
reconstruction.content: Night-out phrases and a designspace diagram

instances.look: A 'Regular ▾' dropdown above a bordered 16-column table of the full character set in small charcoal glyphs on lavender, with faint cell borders
instances.ux: The dropdown re-renders the whole table in Regular, Inktrap, Balloon, Curve or any combination of them (8 options)
instances.learn: For a font with a few custom axes, offer the named corners of the designspace as a dropdown on the glyph grid

reconstruction.layout: ~1924px; col-10 table (~1200px) at x≈135, 16 fixed columns × ~75px, rows ~64px, 1px pale borders
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs ~26px Marbla charcoal centred; dropdown label ~16px
reconstruction.behaviour: changeGlyphsOverview(style) rebuilds the table with font-variation-settings for the chosen axis combination
reconstruction.content: Full set: A–Z with alternates, a–z, two figure styles, accented Latin, superiors/inferiors, punctuation, math, arrows

instances.look: A small black '→ Contact' pill centred above a slim bar with 'Imprint' at left and '© 2026 Katharina Gresch' at right
instances.ux: Contact pill opens an obfuscated mailto; imprint links to the designer's site
instances.learn: One pill button for contact is enough when the font is not for sale

reconstruction.layout: Pill ~110×28px centred; legal bar ~170px with two 12px labels at the content edges (x≈135 and right)
reconstruction.typography: ~13px Marbla Regular; pill text lavender on #24272d
